description:
Eden Foods Sea Salt French Celtic - 14 oz (397 g) Eden Foods Sea Salt French Celtic is lower in sodium and higher in calcium than other salts. This gives a smooth, savory flavor. Eden Foods Sea Salt French Celtic is sea salt in its natural state with trace elements almost identical to the sea. Iodine is not stripped out and then 'fortified' back in. Eden Foods Sea Salt French Celtic is packed in glass to protect it from absorbing moisture. EDEN Sea Salt is certified by ACTOA (L'Association de Controle Tiers Ouest Atlantique), "Selection du Saunier." This organization certifies that the region of Noirmoutier maintains a pure, unpolluted environment suitable for organic agriculture and also respects the Standards of Salt. Atlantic waters flow into Noirmoutier's rectangular, hard sun-baked man-made clay pools. Two days of evaporation from sun and wind create large coarse crystals called 'sel gros'. The crystals are light gray from the clay. They are harvested by the 'saunier' or salt harvester using long rakes to gather the crystals. Using strong, swift strokes the saunier draws crystals to one side of the pool. Every two days the saunier collects small amounts and adds it to the pile that becomes several feet high as the harvest season progresses. The coarse salt is dried and stone ground to medium size to produce Eden Foods Sea Salt French Celtic. No further processing, washing, or additives are involved, and it is never blended. This traditional Celtic process seals in a wealth of trace elements and produces the most delicious sea salt in the world. Noirmoutier islanders take pride in the purity and taste of their salt, just as citizens of Bordeaux take pride in their wine. Their craft has been handed down through generations and the island possesses unique qualities producing one of the most exquisite salts in the world. Sie werden vom "Saunier" oder Salzmärzer geerntet und mit langen Rechen die Kristalle sammeln. Mit starken, schnellen Strichen zieht der Saunier Kristalle auf eine Seite des Pools. Alle zwei Tage sammelt der Saunier kleine Mengen und fügt ihn dem Flor hinzu, der mit dem Fortschritt mehrere Meter hoch wird. Das grobe Salz wird getrocknet und steingemahlen, um Eden Foods Meersalz französisch keltisch zu produzieren. Keine Weiterverarbeitung, Waschen oder Zusätze sind beteiligt, und es wird nie gemischt. Dieser traditionelle keltische Prozess versiegelt eine Fülle von Spurenelementen und produziert das köstlichste Meersalz der Welt. Noirmoutier Inselbewohner sind stolz auf die Reinheit und den Geschmack ihres Salzes, genau wie die Bürger von Bordeaux stolz auf ihren Wein sind. Ihre Handwerkskunst wurde über Generationen weitergegeben und die Insel besitzt einzigartige Eigenschaften, die eines der exquisitesten Salze der Welt produzieren. description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

Salfiore di Romagna is often refered to as "Il Sale dei Papi" or "Pope's Salt" as it is traditionally the seasoning sent to the Papal table. In early modern history, salt production belonged to the bishop of Cervia and was taxed heavily. Today this medium fine grain sea salt is used by saints and sinners alike to season vegetables, carpaccio, sushi, roasted meats, grilled fish, salads and more. Each bag contains 2.2 pounds net weight of Salfiore di Romagna-Il Sale dei Papi Medium Fine Adriatic Sea Salt from Italy.

description:
The Original Wild One is our pure gourmet Grenadine Sea Salt. It is our essential cannot live-or-serve-without-it savory salt. With its’ organically intensified flavor and chunky texture, you don’t want to waste it in the cooking process. We recommend a sprinkling on any and all finished dishes, as it is a powerful flavor enhancer.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

title: Spice Jungle Hawaiian Pink Sea Salt - 4 oz.
bullet_point: [Pink Hawaiian Sea Salt combines pure sea salt with red Hawaiian Alaea clay for a soft, tempered briny flavor, Gorgeous as a finishing salt, it also lends an earthy depth and mellow complexity to dishes, All Natural, Gluten-Free, Kosher Parve, Non-GMO, Spice Jungle Brand - 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed]
description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Olsson’s Sea Salt Flakes are soft, sweet and delicate. This product is made from the pristine sea waters of the Great Australian Bight, is completely natural, chemical and preservative free and retains an exceptional sea salt taste.

The Olsson Family have been making solar sea salt since the 1960's and is the oldest family owned and operated sea salt maker in Australia. Our Raw Macrobiotic Sea Salt is similar to wet celtic sea salts or the French Sel Gris. It remains free from additives or preservatives and retains a high level of natural marine minerals and trace elements.

To make its sea salt, Olsson's use the method called "solar evaporation". Solar salt Is produced by the action of sun and wind on seawater in large ponds. The seawater evaporates in successive ponds until the seawater is fully concentrated and the salt then crystallizes on the floor of the pond.

It is then scooped up, washed in seawater, dried and packaged. That's It.

There are no chemical processes involved In the manufacture of our products, which is why we guarantee it is perfectly natural.

Solar salt plants must be located in areas of low rainfall and high evaporation rates and Olsson’s have the unique advantage of having as its only ingredient seawater from two of the world's most pristine oceans: the Great Barrier Reef (Port Alma, QLD) and the Great Australia Bight (Whyalla, SA). Pristine Australian water, sun and wind work in harmony to create the gorgeous Australian sea salt taste we all love.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

Featuring a specially-designed airtight lid, the cap will close even if some grains of salt stick to the surface or in the hinge. Easily refillable, these salt shakers can be reused again and again.

Una de las maderas más populares para fumar debido a su aroma suave, la madera de manzano envejecida tiene un humo sutilmente dulce y fragante que brilla cuando se combina con carnes más ligeras, como pollo y cerdo. Hemos tomado nuestra sal marina pura y natural y ahumada en frío para crear nuestra sal marina ahumada y salada Yakima Applewood ahumada, exclusivamente de SaltWorks. Suave y fragante, esta sal ahumada artesanal es una manera encantadora de añadir capas de sabor y profundidad a las salsas de barbacoa y guisos de carne, como sustituto de tocino en platos vegetarianos y veganos, como salmuera más sabrosa para el cerdo, o como un frote seco para el pollo. Pruébalo como sal ingrediente y como sal final en verduras y ensaladas al vapor, o en salsas dulces y saladas. Vaya más allá de la barbacoa y la parrilla y use Yakima en auténtica cocina alemana, o emparejado con frutas y chocolates. Frasco de coctelera: hecho de policarbonato sin BPA, nuestros saleros parecen vidrio pero son irrompibles y duraderos para el uso diario. Con una tapa hermética especialmente diseñada, la tapa se cerrará incluso si algunos granos de sal se adhieren a la superficie o en la bisagra. Fácilmente recargables, estos saleros se pueden reutilizar una y otra vez.

אחד העצים הפופולריים ביותר לעישון בשל ניחוח מתון, עץ תפוח מיושן יש עשן מתוק וריחני אשר זורח כאשר הוא משולב עם בשרים קלים יותר, כגון עוף וחזיר. לקחנו את מלח הים הטהור והטבעי שלנו ועישננו אותו בקור כדי ליצור את מלח הים המעושן והמלוח שלנו Yakima Applewood המעושן, באופן בלעדי מ-SaltWorks. רך וריחני, מלח מעושן זה הוא דרך נהדרת להוסיף שכבות של טעם ועומק לרטבי ברביקיו ותבשילי בקר, כתחליף בייקון במנות צמחוניות וטבעוניות, כמלח טעים יותר לבשר חזיר, או כשפשוף יבש לעוף. נסו אותו גם כמלח מרכיב וגם כמלח גימור על ירקות וסלטים מאודים, או במטבלים מתוקים ומלוחים. לכו מעבר לברביקיו ולגריל והשתמשו ב-Yakima במטבח הגרמני האותנטי, או בשילוב עם פירות ושוקולדים. צנצנת שייקר: עשוי מפוליקרבונט ללא BPA, שייקרים המלח שלנו נראים כמו זכוכית אך הם בלתי שבירים ועמידים לשימוש יומיומי. כולל מכסה אטום מעוצב במיוחד, המכסה ייסגר גם אם חלק מגרגרי מלח נדבקים למשטח או בציר. ניתן למילוי חוזר בקלות, שייקרים אלה ניתנים לשימוש חוזר שוב ושוב.

Eines der beliebtesten Hölzer zum Räuchern aufgrund seines milden Aromas hat gealtertes Apfelholz einen dezent süßen, duftenden Rauch, der in Kombination mit leichterem Fleisch wie Huhn und Schweinefleisch glänzt. Wir haben unser reines, natürliches Meersalz in Flockenform genommen und kalt geräuchert, um unser rauchiges, herzhaftes Yakima-Apfelholz geräuchertes Meersalz zu kreieren, exklusiv von SaltWorks. Weich und duftend, dieses handwerkliche Räuchersalz ist eine schöne Möglichkeit, um Grillsoßen und Rindfleischeintöpfen Schichten von Geschmack und Tiefe zu verleihen, als Speckersatz in vegetarischen und veganen Gerichten, als aromatischere Salzlösung für Schweinefleisch oder als Trockenreibung für Huhn. Probieren Sie es sowohl als Zutatensalz als auch als Finish-Salz auf gedämpftem Gemüse und Salaten oder sowohl in süßen als auch herzhaften Dips. Gehen Sie über das BBQ und Grillen hinaus und verwenden Sie Yakima in authentischer deutscher Küche oder gepaart mit Früchten und Schokolade. Streudose aus BPA-freiem Polycarbonat, unsere Salzstreuer sehen aus wie Glas, sind aber unzerbrechlich und langlebig für den täglichen Gebrauch. Mit einem speziell entwickelten, luftdichten Deckel schließt sich die Kappe, auch wenn einige Salzkörner an der Oberfläche oder im Scharnier haften. Leicht nachfüllbar, diese Salzstreuer können immer wieder verwendet werden.

أحد أكثر الأخشاب شعبية للتدخين بسبب رائحته الخفيفة، يتميز خشب التفاح القديم بدخان حلو وعطر يتألق عند دمجه مع اللحم الفاتح، مثل الدجاج والخنزير. لقد أخذنا ملح البحر الطبيعي النقي الذي ننتجه ونشفه بالتدخين البارد لصنع ملح البحر المدخن ياكيما المذاق والمدخن حصريًا من SaltWorks. هذا الملح المدخن المصنوع بحرفية ناعم وعطر، هو طريقة جميلة لإضافة طبقات من النكهة والعمق إلى صلصات الشواء وساخنة اللحم البقري، كبديل عن اللحم المقدد في الأطباق النباتية والنباتية، أو كمحلول ملحي أكثر نكهة للحنزير، أو كفرك جاف للدجاج. جربيه كملح مكون وكملح بلمسة نهائية على الخضروات والسلطات المطهية على البخار أو في الغمس الحلو والمذاق. انطلق إلى أبعد من الشواء والشواء واستخدم ياكيما في المطبخ الألماني الأصلي، أو مع الفواكه والشوكولاتة. وعاء شيكر: مصنوع من البولي كربونات الخالي من البيسفينول، فرجار الملح الخاص بنا يبدو مثل الزجاج ولكنه غير قابل للكسر ومتين للاستخدام اليومي. يتميز بغطاء محكم مصمم خصيصًا، وسيغلق الغطاء حتى إذا تلصق بعض حبيبات الملح على السطح أو على المفصل. يمكن إعادة ملئها بسهولة، ويمكن إعادة استخدام عبوات الملح هذه مرارًا وتكرارًا.

Uma das madeiras mais populares para fumar devido ao seu aroma suave, a madeira de maçã envelhecida tem uma fumaça sutilmente doce e perfumada que brilha quando combinada com carnes mais leves, como frango e porco. Pegamos nosso sal marinho puro e natural e defumamos o frio para criar nosso sal marinho defumado de maçã Yakima e salgado, exclusivamente da SaltWorks. Macio e perfumado, este sal defumado artesanal é uma maneira adorável de adicionar camadas de sabor e profundidade aos molhos de churrasco e ensopados de carne, como um substituto de bacon em pratos vegetarianos e veganos, como uma salmoura mais saborosa para carne de porco, ou como um esfregão seco para frango. Experimente como um ingrediente de sal e como um sal final em legumes e saladas vaporizados, ou em molhos doces e salgados. Vá além do churrasco e da grelha e use Yakima na autêntica cozinha alemã ou juntamente com frutas e chocolates. Pote de coqueteleira: Feito de policarbonato livre de BPA, nossos saleiros parecem vidro, mas são inquebráveis e duráveis para o uso diário. Com uma tampa hermética especialmente projetada, a tampa fechará mesmo que alguns grãos de sal grudem na superfície ou na dobradiça. Facilmente recarregável, estes saleiro podem ser reutilizados várias vezes.

由于其温和的香气,是广受欢迎的烟熏木之一,陈年苹果木具有微妙的甜美香味,与鸡肉和猪肉等较轻的肉搭配时闪闪发光。 我们采用纯净、天然海盐和冷熏制,创造出由 SaltWorks 独家生产烟熏、美味的山雀苹果木烟熏海盐。 这款手工熏制盐柔软芳香,可为烧烤酱和炖牛肉增添层次感和深度,是素食和素食菜肴的培根替代品,猪肉的美味盐水,或作为鸡肉的干擦。 在蒸蔬菜和沙拉上作为配料盐和精加工盐,或者在甜和咸的蘸酱中尝试。 超越烧烤和烧烤，也可以在正宗的德国菜肴中使用Yakima，或搭配水果和巧克力。 调味罐:采用不含 BPA 的聚碳酸酯制成,我们的盐瓶看起来像玻璃,但不易破损,持久耐用,适合日常使用。 采用特别设计的密封盖,即使一些盐粘在表面或铰链上,也不会盖上。 这些盐瓶易于重新灌装,可反复使用。

由於其溫和的香味,作為吸煙最受歡迎的木材之一,老化 Applewood 具有微妙的甜美香煙,與雞肉和豬肉等較輕的肉類搭配時閃耀。 我們採用了純天然雪花海鹽和冷煙,創造出我們煙燻、美味的亞基馬 Applewood 煙燻海鹽,SaltWorks 獨家出品。 這款手工煙燻鹽質地柔軟,芬芳,為 BBQ 醬汁和牛肉燉菜增添一層風味和深度的可愛方式,可作為素食和素食菜餚的培根替代品,可作為豬肉更美味的鹽水,或作為雞肉乾擦。 在蒸蔬菜和沙拉上作為鹽份和成品鹽,或者在甜鹹的浸漬中嘗試。 不只是燒烤和燒烤,在正宗的德國料理中使用 Yakima ,或搭配水果和巧克力。 調味罐:採用不含雙酚 A 的聚碳酸酯製成,我們的鹽罐看起來像玻璃,但不易碎且耐用,適合日常使用。 採用特別設計的密閉蓋,即使有些鹽粒粘在表面或鉸鏈上,蓋子也會關閉。 ​ 可輕鬆補充,這些鹽罐可以一次又一次重複使用。

순한 향기로 인해 훈연용으로 가장 인기 있는 나무 중 하나인 사과나무는 닭고기와 돼지고기와 짝을 이루면 은은하게 달콤하고 향기로운 연기가 납니다. 저희는 솔트웍스 독점 생산의 순수한 천연 플레이크 바다 소금을 가져 차가운 훈제로 훈제하여 스모키하고 맛있는 야키마 사과나무 훈제 바다 소금을 만듭니다. 부드럽고 향기로운 이 장인 훈제 소금은 BBQ 소스와 쇠고기 스튜에 맛과 깊이를 더하는 사랑스러운 방법입니다. 채식주의자 및 비건 요리의 베이컨 대체품, 돼지 고기의 맛 좋은 염수, 또는 닭고기의 마른 문질러서 사용할 수 있습니다. 찜 야채와 샐러드 또는 달콤하고 맛있는 딥 모두에 재료 소금과 마무리 소금으로 사용해보세요. 바베큐 및 그릴을 넘어 정통 독일 요리에 야키마를 사용하거나 과일과 초콜릿과 짝을 이뤄보세요. 셰이커 병: BPA 프리 폴리카보네이트로 제작된 소금 셰이커는 유리처럼 보이지만 깨지지 않고 내구성이 뛰어납니다. 특수 설계된 밀폐 뚜껑이 특징이며, 소금의 일부 입자가 표면이나 경첩에 붙어도 뚜껑이 닫힙니다. 쉽게 리필할 수 있는 이 소금 셰이커는 반복해서 재사용이 가능합니다.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Himalayan Pink Salt (also known as red, rose, Tibetan or Sherpa salt) was formed over 250 million years ago during the Jurassic era and is found in the Himalayan mountains.
This unique salt is mined from the ancient sea beds inside the mountains, which were once covered by lava.
This lava created a natural barrier to protect the salt from toxins and pollutants and ensures that Himalayan Pink Salt is considered to be the purest salt on earth.

Pink salt from the Himalayas has been used as a valuable spice for millennia and the people who live in the Himalayan region around Nepal and Pakistan have been using it to flavor, preserve and serve their food for thousands of years. It was also valued for its beauty and is naturally colored pink to light red or rose due to the rock salt’s unique mineral composition.

Sundhed has its roots in the Himalayan region and has sourced the highest quality, food-grade pink Himalayan salt from Pakistan for many years.
Our salt is unrefined with no artificial colours added and is all-natural, organic, keto-friendly and Kosher certified.

Himalayan pink salt is great for food lovers and chefs of all levels. Our salt is excellent for curing, finishing, seasoning and grilling meats, fish and vegetables.

SEASON: add flavour to meats, fish, eggs, vegetables, soups, stews, pasta and potato salads.
BAKE: blend into your family favorites like bread and muffins.
BBQ: finish your barbecue grilled meats, fish and vegetables.
PICKLE & CAN: salt vegetables before pickling and canning to add extra flavor.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. title: Artisan Salt Company Fleur de Sel French Flower of Salt, Pour Spout Pouch, 15 Ounce
bullet_point: [GOURMET SEA SALT: Cherished for its natural moisture, unique texture and balanced flavor, SaltWorks Fleur de Sel is an exceptional addition to any dish from grilled fish and steamed vegetables to chocolate ice cream, CAVIAR OF SALT: Using centuries-old harvesting techniques and wooden tools, Fleur de Sel is carefully harvested by hand from the surface of salt ponds in the Guérande region of France, POUR-SPOUT POUCH: Available in a smaller bulk option, our kitchen and pantry friendly pour-spout pouch makes measuring out salt and refilling shakers and jars easy, ARTISAN COLLECTION: Fleur de Sel French Flower of Salt is a part of SaltWorks Artisan line featuring all-natural traditional sea salts, artisanal finishing salts and delicious smoked salts, COMMITTED TO QUALITY: We’re passionate about producing all-natural sea salts that are organic compliant, OU Kosher certified, non-GMO, chemical free, allergen free and gluten free]
description:
Delicate, moist and crunchy—Fleur de Sel is known as “the caviar of salts” by chefs around the world. The result of a cool evening wind gently blowing across the surface of salt ponds in Guérande, France, delicate crystals blossom quickly and are gathered early in the morning using traditional wooden tools. This tender harvesting process leaves the crystals intact and helps them retain their natural moisture. Used by cooks worldwide when seasoning their favorite foods, Fleur de Sel is one of the most treasured finishing salts for gourmet dishes, adding subtle salinity and crunch, and in spice & herb blends, as it helps to breakdown herbs and open up their flavor.

Zart, feucht und knusprig — Fleur de Sel ist bekannt als "der Kaviar der Salze" von Köchen auf der ganzen Welt. Das Ergebnis eines kühlen Abendwindes, der sanft über die Oberfläche der Salzteiche in Guérande, Frankreich, weht zarte Kristalle schnell und werden früh am Morgen mit traditionellen Holzwerkzeugen gesammelt. Dieser zarte Ernteprozess lässt die Kristalle intakt und hilft ihnen, ihre natürliche Feuchtigkeit zu bewahren. Fleur de Sel wird weltweit von Köchen verwendet, wenn sie ihre Lieblingsspeisen würzen. Fleur de Sel ist eines der wertvollsten Finish-Salz für Gourmet-Gerichte, fügt subtile Salinität und Crunch hinzu, und in Gewürz- und Kräutermischungen, da es hilft, Kräuter zu zerbrechen und ihren Geschmack zu öffnen.

עדין, לח ופריך - Fleur de Sel ידוע בשם "קוויאר של מלחים" על ידי שפים ברחבי העולם. התוצאה של רוח ערב קרירה נושבת בעדינות על פני השטח של בריכות המלח בגרנדה, צרפת, קריסטלים עדינים פורחים במהירות ונאספים מוקדם בבוקר באמצעות כלי עץ מסורתיים. תהליך הקציר העדין הזה משאיר את הקריסטלים בשלמים ומסייע להם לשמור על הלחות הטבעית שלהם. בשימוש על ידי טבחים ברחבי העולם בעת תיבול המאכלים האהובים עליהם, Fleur de Sel הוא אחד מלחי הגמר היקרים ביותר עבור מנות גורמה, הוספת מליחות עדינה ופרינץ', ובתערובות תבלינים ועשבים, שכן הוא עוזר לפרק עשבי תיבול ולפתוח את הטעם שלהם.

Delicado, úmido e crocante — a Fleur de Sel é conhecida como "o caviar de sais" por chefs de todo o mundo. O resultado de um vento noturno fresco suavemente soprando pela superfície de lagos de sal em Guérande, França, cristais delicados florescem rapidamente e são reunidos no início da manhã usando ferramentas de madeira tradicionais. Este processo de colheita suave deixa os cristais intactos e os ajuda a manter sua umidade natural. Usado por cozinheiros em todo o mundo ao temperar seus alimentos favoritos, o Fleur de Sel é um dos mais valiosos sais de acabamento para pratos gourmet, adicionando salinidade e crocância sutil, e em misturas de especiarias e ervas, pois ajuda a quebrar ervas e abrir seu sabor.

精致、湿润、脆 — Fleur de Sel 被世界各地的厨师称为"鱼子酱"。 在法国盖兰德的盐池表面微风吹拂冷的夜晚,精致的水晶盛开迅速,清晨使用传统木制工具聚集在一起。 这种柔软的收获工艺使晶体完好无损,帮助它们保持天然水分。 世界各地的厨师在调味自己喜爱的食物时,Fleur de Sel 是一款珍贵的成品盐,用来制作美味菜肴,添加微妙的盐分和碎片,添加香料和草药混合物,因为它有助于分解草药,打开他们的口味。

섬세하고 촉촉하며 바삭한 Fleur de Sel은 전 세계 요리사들이 "소금의 캐비어"로 알려져 있습니다. 시원한 저녁 바람이 프랑스 게란데의 소금 연못 표면을 가로질러 부드럽게 불어오면서 섬세한 크리스탈이 빠르게 피어나고 아침 일찍 전통적인 목재 도구를 사용하여 모입니다. 이 부드러운 수확 과정은 크리스탈을 그대로 유지하고 자연스러운 수분을 유지하도록 도와줍니다. 전 세계 요리사가 좋아하는 음식을 시즈닝할 때 사용하는 Fleur de Sel은 미식 요리를 위한 가장 소중한 마무리 소금 중 하나이며, 미묘한 염분과 크런치를 추가하고, 향신료 및 허브 블렌드로 허브를 분해하고 맛을 높이는 데 도움이 됩니다.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

This lava created a natural barrier to protect the salt from toxins and pollutants and ensures that Himalayan Pink Salt is considered to be the purest salt on earth.

It was also valued for its beauty and is naturally colored pink to light red or rose due to the rock salt’s unique mineral composition.

Sundhed has its roots in the Himalayan region and has sourced the highest quality, food-grade pink Himalayan salt from Pakistan for many years.

Frequently Asked Questions About Spring Salt

So, What's Spring Salt? Spring salt is a mineral salt that is hand harvested by a local community tucked away in the Andes Mountains of Peru. The community evaporates this salty spring water from a pristine aquifer during the summer months and harvests the leftover natural grains using traditional methods. This source is one of the only places in the world where you can source spring salt.

What Makes It Healthier Than Sea Salt? It's no secret these days that ocean water is loaded with microplastics and other toxic material. Unfortunately these pollutants are impossible to remove from ocean water and end up in nearly all the sea salt we eat. Spring salt is harvested from an underground spring untouched by human pollution. A healthier salt alternative for those who care about what is going into their bodies. No one knows for sure how microplastics impact our bodies, but it's just not something we'd like to take a chance on.

What Does It Taste Like? Sea salt tastes like a harsh gulp of ocean water, while spring salt tastes fresh, mellow, and sweet due to its high mineral content and no added chemicals. The perfect ingredient for any of your cooking needs.

How Do I Use It? Spring salt is a naturally coarse grain, perfect for pinching and tossing. If you prefer smaller grains it can be easily added to refill any household salt grinder.

Does Spring Salt Contain Chemicals? Absolutely not! While most refined salts contain anticaking chemicals and are bleached, spring salt is harvested using natural methods, packed, and sent right to you. We'll never add any chemicals. Ever.

description:
Olsson’s Sea Salt Flakes are soft, sweet and delicate. This product is made from the pristine sea waters of the Great Australian Bight, is completely natural, chemical and preservative free and retains an exceptional sea salt taste.

The Olsson Family have been making solar sea salt since the 1960's and is the oldest family owned and operated sea salt maker in Australia. Our Raw Macrobiotic Sea Salt is similar to wet celtic sea salts or the French Sel Gris. It remains free from additives or preservatives and retains a high level of natural marine minerals and trace elements.

To make its sea salt, Olsson's use the method called "solar evaporation". Solar salt Is produced by the action of sun and wind on seawater in large ponds. The seawater evaporates in successive ponds until the seawater is fully concentrated and the salt then crystallizes on the floor of the pond.

It is then scooped up, washed in seawater, dried and packaged. That's It.

There are no chemical processes involved In the manufacture of our products, which is why we guarantee it is perfectly natural.

Solar salt plants must be located in areas of low rainfall and high evaporation rates and Olsson’s have the unique advantage of having as its only ingredient seawater from two of the world's most pristine oceans: the Great Barrier Reef (Port Alma, QLD) and the Great Australia Bight (Whyalla, SA). Pristine Australian water, sun and wind work in harmony to create the gorgeous Australian sea salt taste we all love.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

Cooking Instructions
For an electric/gas Stovetop
If heating on the stovetop, select a circular ring of metal, such as a tart pan with a pop out bottom, pastry ring, or wok ring, and place it on the burner. Place the salt slab on top of the ring. Place a circular ring of metal such as a tart pan with a pop-out bottom to create a small air gap between the heating element and the block. Once set up, heat similarly to a gas range.

FOR THE GRILL/BARBECUE
Place your salt slab on the grate. If using a charcoal grill, keep the coals to one side and place the slab on the other side, to expose it to less direct heat. If using a gas grill, start the heat on low as you would with a gas range. Increase heat slowly until the slab is ready to use, as described in the gas range instructions.

FOR AN OVEN
We do not recommend using an oven to heat your salt slab, as damage to your salt slab and/or your oven may result. If you would like to bake on your slab, heat it as described on the stovetop or grill to at least three hundred degrees and then move it into a hot oven.

يتمتع دخان الجوز بعلاقة دائمة مع القيقب والعسل والخنزير ويضيف لمسة من الأومامي إلى الأطباق الحلوة والمالحة. انطلق إلى أبعد من اللحم المزجج ولحم الخنزير المقدد المالح وتوجه مغامرة رائعة مع ملح البحر المدخن من دورانجو هيكوري الخاص بنا. ملح البحر المصنوع من رقائق طبيعية بالكامل وخشب الجوز الحقيقي غير المعالج، هذا الملح البحري هو نتيجة عطرية لعملية التدخين البارد المثالية من ملح ووركس، والتي تشع ملح البحر برائحة الجوكر المميزة. تعمل الرقائق الصغيرة بشكل رائع عند مزجها في وصفات، وكذلك عند استخدامها كملح بلمسة نهائية لذيذة. عند إضافته إلى الصلصات واليخن، تذوب رقائق دورانجو بالتساوي وبسرعة لتوزيع النكهة بسلاسة وغني بالملح. سواء كنت تضيف القليل أو كثيرًا، فإن هذا الملح المدخن اللذيذ يتجاوز الشواء وهو مكمل مثالي للديك الرومي المحمص أو اللحوم الحمراء المختلفة أو الأطباق ذات النمط الجنوبي. لماذا تتوقف هناك؟ جربي الأطباق الحلوة، أيضًا، بإضافة القليل إلى فطيرة الخوخ أو إلى تفاح زبدة القيقب المخبوزة. كيس الصنبور: تتميز هذه الأكياس الملائمة للمطبخ ومخزن الأطعمة بفوهة سكب سهلة الاستخدام تجعل إعادة تعبئة عبوات الملح والمطاحن والبرطمانات سهلاً. متوفر الآن بمقاس كبير أصغر ومريح. تستخدم لإعادة التعبئة وإعادة الاستخدام وكرر هزازات الملح الاحترافية والمطاحن السيراميكية أو لقياس الملح بسهولة للطهي والخبز.

title: Fiore di Sale – Flower Salt Gucciardo – Trapani, Sicily - 7 oz
bullet_point: [Artisanal Sea Salt from the Salt Planes of Trapani, Sicily, by Vincenzo Gucciardo, Unwashed and not treated chemically, entirely processes by hand, Retains characteristic moisture, Mild salinity, rich in potassium and magnesium, A jar of 200 gr - 7 oz]
description: Fiore del sale, or the flower of salt, is also referred to as the “caviar of salts” - and like caviar it is best eaten raw. This salt flower's lovely light, snowflake shaped particles are naturally rich in iodine, fluorine, magnesium and potassium, with a much lower percentage of sodium chloride than regular table salt. A small quantity of this fiore di sale, gathered from Mediterranean seawater along the northwest coast of Sicilia, is sufficient to salt your favorite dishes. Sprinkle this high quality finishing salt on roasted potatoes and homemade french fries, salads, grilled meat or fish, and fresh sliced tomatoes. On the picturesque Trapanese coastline dotted with windmills, shallow pools and white salt pyramids, the summer salt harvest is a tradition that dates back thousands of years, since at least the time of the ancient Greeks and Romans. Trapani Sea Salt di Gucciardo is produced using a salt mill built in 1884 in Trapani’s natural reserve, protected by the World Wide Fund for Nature, home to migratory birds like purple herons and grey parrots. Each spring, the salt pans are filled with seawater, which is left to evaporate in the heat of the Sicilian summer sun and strong African winds. As the water evaporates and the salt starts to crystallize, the fiore del sale are the young salt crystals that form on the top. Enzo, Salvatore and their team collect the salt by hand with shovels - in the scorching heat of July and August - with a passionate dedication to the traditions of their land. The salt is completely unrefined and untreated, unlike industrial salt, which is harvested by machines that pollute the salt; it then must be washed and stripped of its natural minerals, which are re-added with chemicals. In addition to his magnificent fior del sale, Enzo and Salvatore Gucciardo produces artisanal fine and coarse salt.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

Our Difference

Table salt & sea salt are both fundamentally made from salt taken from seawater, but that’s where the similarity ends. Table salt is highly ‘refined’ so that everything that is not sodium chloride is processed out for uniformity & mass production. The minute the seawater is boiled, & even some gourmet sea salt brands are, it loses its potent benefits. The seawater is collected & delivered to our holding tanks, where it is then solar evaporated in our uniquely designed, patent pending stills, allowing us to provide the highest quality sea salt, free of any contaminants & retaining the highest levels of healthy minerals, essential trace elements & rich flavors specific to these waters.

Health Benefits

Grenadine Sea Salt has been FDA laboratory tested to reveal less sodium & less chloride as well as higher concentrations of healthy essential minerals & trace elements than other leading gourmet brands. Lab tests also indicated high levels of sulfate, a mineral key in boosting metabolism & the immune system as well as detoxifying benefits for a strong, healthy body as well as promoting heart endurance & vitality.

What Are Finishing Salts?

Finishing salts differ from processed salts in flavor, texture, & appearance. With a higher moisture content than manufactured salt, our hand crafted sea salt it retains its crystal structure & does not have the drying out effect of table salt. Our salts are the perfect flavor enhancer, making everything taste better.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

Salt Works 的全天然鹹檀木煙燻海鹽的美味多功能性,使其成為最受歡迎的煙燻海鹽選擇之一。 Salish 是第一個煙燻鹽,經過完美的 48 小時冷煙過程和多種穀物尺寸,為我們其他品種奠定了標準。 天然、紅色榿木的強烈煙霧是傳統太平洋西北部的一對,適合鮭魚和其他乳霜、更豐富的海鮮,但煙霧的適應性輪廓只會增強任何類型的肉類或家禽,甚至是蔬菜。 為各種食譜添加正宗煙燻風味的完全自然方式,這款鹽是燒烤或燒烤的理想夥伴,但冒險超越紅肉。 為湯和醬汁添加深度,只需噴灑即可完成沙拉和炒蔬菜,與其他香料混合,以實現特製調料混合,或加入鹽水,在您最喜愛的豬排中享受煙燻、鹹味。 在烤架上或關閉時,用 Salish Alderwood 享受全天然煙熏風味。 調味罐:採用不含雙酚 A 的聚碳酸酯製成,我們的鹽罐看起來像玻璃,但不易碎且耐用,適合日常使用。 採用特別設計的密閉蓋,即使有些鹽粒粘在表面或鉸鏈上,蓋子也會關閉。 ​ 可輕鬆補充,這些鹽罐可以一次又一次重複使用。

Salt Works 的全天然Salish Alderwood 烟熏海盐的美味多功能;使其成为最受欢迎的烟熏海盐品之一。 我们首款烟熏盐,Salish 通过完善的 48 小时冷烟工艺和多种谷物尺寸,为我们其他品种设定了标准。 天然红麦芽木的浓烟是传统太平洋西北部的三文鱼和其他奶油、海鲜的浓烟,但烟雾的可调风味几乎可以增强任何类型的肉类或家禽,甚至是蔬菜。 这款盐是烧烤或烧烤的理想伴侣，除了红肉之外，它也是烧烤或烧烤的理想伴侣。 为汤和酱汁增加深度,只需一个撒上即可完成沙拉和炒蔬菜,与其他香料混合,打造定制调味混合物,或添加盐水,在您喜爱的猪排中散发烟熏、咸味。 在烧烤或关闭时,使用 Salish Alderwood 全年享受全天然烟熏风味。 调味罐:采用不含 BPA 的聚碳酸酯制成,我们的盐瓶看起来像玻璃,但不易破损,持久耐用,适合日常使用。 采用特别设计的密封盖,即使一些盐粘在表面或铰链上,也不会盖上。 这些盐瓶易于重新灌装,可反复使用。

Salt Works의 천연 살리쉬 앨더우드 훈제 바다 소금의 맛있고 다양성은 훈제 바다 소금의 가장 인기 있는 선택 중 하나입니다. 당사의 첫 번째 훈제 소금인 Salish는 48시간 냉간 훈제 공정과 다양한 곡물 크기로 완벽한 다른 품종의 바를 만들었습니다. 천연 레드 오리나무의 강렬한 연기는 전통적으로 태평양 북서부 연어 및 기타 크리미하고 풍부한 해산물을 위한 한 쌍이지만, 연기의 적응형 맛 프로필은 모든 유형의 고기나 가금류, 채소까지 향상시킵니다. 다양한 레시피에 정통 훈제 맛을 더하는 완전히 자연스러운 방법인 이 소금은 그릴이나 바베큐에 이상적인 파트너이지만 붉은 고기를 넘어 탐험할 수 있습니다. 스프와 소스에 깊이를 더하고, 스프링클로 샐러드와 야채를 볶고, 다른 향신료와 섞어 맞춤형 시즈닝 블렌드를 만들거나, 좋아하는 돼지갈비 전체에 소금물에 훈제하고 짠맛을 더해보세요. 그릴이나 오프에서 Salish Alderwood와 함께 일년 내내 천연 훈제 맛을 즐기세요. 셰이커 병: BPA 프리 폴리카보네이트로 제작된 소금 셰이커는 유리처럼 보이지만 깨지지 않고 내구성이 뛰어납니다. 특수 설계된 밀폐 뚜껑이 특징이며, 소금의 일부 입자가 표면이나 경첩에 붙어도 뚜껑이 닫힙니다. 쉽게 리필할 수 있는 이 소금 셰이커는 반복해서 재사용이 가능합니다.

Iberian Salt is harvested following the tradition of producing salt based on lunar phases which minimize impurities. Iberian Salt retains its moisture due to its natural, unrefined state and rich magnesium content. Due to its high moisture content, it cannot be broken down with a mechanical grinder. It can be used in its coarse crystal form or ground with a mortar and pestle. The best way to store Iberian Salt is in a glass, wooden or ceramic container with a loose fitting lid (no metal).The benefits of using unrefined sea salt from a vibrant, living ocean are numerous.

Use the Cyprus Black on the mozzarella cheese and Cyprus White on the tomatoes and basil, it also looks great.

This is a unique and versatile product which is 100% natural, with all natural flavoring. The production process can take up to two years, in order to achieve the perfect balance of weather and temperature to create the right texture and flavor. On the Island of Cyprus, Sea salt flakes are made in the traditional manner, through the evaporation of seawater. The sea water is channeled through a series of ponds or into shallow lagoons called salins. The water is then fed into large pans where it is slowly heated until delicate pyramid crystals form. The process repeats until the sea salt reaches 3% humidity.

This process is also environmentally friendly, fueled mostly by solar power.

description: Our Maras salt is the result of the process of natural evaporation from a spring that flows from the mountains that surround the Sacred Valley of the Incas. It is believed that its origin is an ancient ocean that remained trapped millions of years ago in the subsoil more than 3,300 meters above sea level and just a few kilometers from the city of Cusco. This natural ingredient has been harvested on a small scale by the Maras community for centuries, using the same techniques employed by the Incas to obtain a pink, coarse grain of salt, rich in minerals such as iron, calcium and magnesium that give it a unique and special flavor. Maras is a town in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, 40 kilometers north of Cusco, in the Cusco Region of Peru. The town is well known for its salt evaporation ponds, located towards Urubamba from the town center, which have been in use since Inca times. The salt-evaporation ponds are down a canyon that descends to the Rio Vilcanota and the Sacred Valley of the Incas. There are over 5,000 salt ponds, owned by families Since pre-Inca times, salt has been obtained in Maras by evaporating salty water from a local subterranean stream. The highly salty water emerges at a spring, a natural outlet of the underground stream. The flow is directed into an intricate system of tiny channels constructed so that the water runs gradually down onto the several hundred ancient terraced ponds. The altitude of the ponds slowly decreases, so that the water may flow through the myriad branches of the water-supply channels and be introduced slowly through a notch in one sidewall of each pond. The proper maintenance of the adjacent feeder channel, the side walls and the water-entry notch, the pond's bottom surface, the quantity of water, and the removal of accumulated salt deposits requires close cooperation among the community of users.

description:
Alaea clay is a volcanic byproduct. When sea salt is evaporated it mixes with this clay that gets its color from high amounts of iron oxide. The result is a salt that has a slight flavor of clay and metal. It might sound off-putting, but the flavor is extremely pleasant. It’s a perfect finishing salt for root vegetables, white fish, and pork.

Red salt is essentially the same as pink salt, but pink salt has less of the alaea clay. The result is less mineral in flavor allowing the salt itself to shine. Less clay also means less moisture, so the salt won’t melt. Instead, it stays rocky and shatters in a satisfying way when bitten into.

Pink and red Hawaiian salts are also becoming very popular for use in confections. Often, it is paired with chocolate to intensify the bitter and sweet flavors.

bullet_point: [GOURMET SEA SALT: Cherished for its natural moisture, unique texture and balanced flavor, SaltWorks Fleur de Sel is an exceptional addition to any dish from grilled fish and steamed vegetables to chocolate ice cream, COMMITTED TO QUALITY: We’re passionate about producing all-natural sea salts that are organic compliant, OU Kosher certified, non-GMO, chemical free, allergen free and gluten free, CAVIAR OF SALT: Using centuries-old harvesting techniques and wooden tools, Fleur de Sel is carefully harvested by hand from the surface of salt ponds in the Guérande region of France, ZIP-TOP POUCH: SaltWorks convenient zip-top pouch seals in freshness and offers the ideal amount of salt to use in all of your favorite recipes., ARTISAN COLLECTION: Fleur de Sel is part of SaltWorks Artisan line featuring all-natural traditional salts, artisanal finishing salts and delicious smoked salts]
description:
Delicate, moist and crunchy—Fleur de Sel is known as “the caviar of salts” by chefs around the world. The result of a cool evening wind gently blowing across the surface of salt ponds in Guérande, France, delicate crystals blossom quickly and are gathered early in the morning using traditional wooden tools. This tender harvesting process leaves the crystals intact and helps them retain their natural moisture. Used by cooks worldwide when seasoning their favorite foods, Fleur de Sel is one of the most treasured finishing salts for gourmet dishes, adding subtle salinity and crunch, and in spice & herb blends, as it helps to breakdown herbs and open up their flavor.

Delicado, húmedo y crujiente: Fleur de Sel es conocido como "el caviar de las sales" por los chefs de todo el mundo. El resultado de un viento fresco de la tarde que sopla suavemente sobre la superficie de los estanques de sal en Guérande, Francia, los delicados cristales florecen rápidamente y se recogen temprano en la mañana utilizando herramientas de madera tradicionales. Este tierno proceso de cosecha deja los cristales intactos y les ayuda a retener su humedad natural. Utilizado por cocineros de todo el mundo al condimentar sus alimentos favoritos, Fleur de Sel es una de las sales de acabado más preciadas para platos gourmet, agregando sutiles salinidad y crujido, y en mezclas de especias y hierbas, ya que ayuda a descomponer las hierbas y abrir su sabor.

עדין, לח ופריך - Fleur de Sel ידוע בשם "קוויאר של מלחים" על ידי שפים ברחבי העולם. התוצאה של רוח ערב קרירה נושבת בעדינות על פני השטח של בריכות המלח בגרנדה, צרפת, קריסטלים עדינים פורחים במהירות ונאספים מוקדם בבוקר באמצעות כלי עץ מסורתיים. תהליך הקציר העדין הזה משאיר את הקריסטלים בשלמים ומסייע להם לשמור על הלחות הטבעית שלהם. בשימוש על ידי טבחים ברחבי העולם בעת תיבול המאכלים האהובים עליהם, Fleur de Sel הוא אחד מלחי הגמר היקרים ביותר עבור מנות גורמה, הוספת מליחות עדינה ופרינץ', ובתערובות תבלינים ועשבים, שכן הוא עוזר לפרק עשבי תיבול ולפתוח את הטעם שלהם.

Zart, feucht und knusprig — Fleur de Sel ist bekannt als "der Kaviar der Salze" von Köchen auf der ganzen Welt. Das Ergebnis eines kühlen Abendwindes, der sanft über die Oberfläche der Salzteiche in Guérande, Frankreich, weht zarte Kristalle schnell und werden früh am Morgen mit traditionellen Holzwerkzeugen gesammelt. Dieser zarte Ernteprozess lässt die Kristalle intakt und hilft ihnen, ihre natürliche Feuchtigkeit zu bewahren. Fleur de Sel wird weltweit von Köchen verwendet, wenn sie ihre Lieblingsspeisen würzen. Fleur de Sel ist eines der wertvollsten Finish-Salz für Gourmet-Gerichte, fügt subtile Salinität und Crunch hinzu, und in Gewürz- und Kräutermischungen, da es hilft, Kräuter zu zerbrechen und ihren Geschmack zu öffnen.

رقيق ومرطب ومقرمش- يُعرف فلور دي سيل باسم "كافيار الأملاح" من قبل الطهاة في جميع أنحاء العالم. نتيجة الرياح المسائية الباردة التي تنتفخ بلطف على سطح بركة الملح في غيراند بفرنسا، تزهر الكريستالات الرقيقة بسرعة ويتم جمعها في الصباح الباكر باستخدام الأدوات الخشبية التقليدية. عملية الحصاد الرقيقة هذه تترك الكريستالات سليمة وتساعد على الاحتفاظ برطوبتها الطبيعية. تستخدم فلور دي سيل من قبل الطهاة في جميع أنحاء العالم عند تحضير طعامهم المفضلة، وهي واحدة من أكثر أملاح اللمسات النهائية لأطباق الذواقة، وتضيف ملوحة رقيقة ومقرمشة، ومزيج التوابل والأعشاب، لأنها تساعد على تفتيت الأعشاب وفتح نكهاتها.

Delicado, úmido e crocante — a Fleur de Sel é conhecida como "o caviar de sais" por chefs de todo o mundo. O resultado de um vento noturno fresco suavemente soprando pela superfície de lagos de sal em Guérande, França, cristais delicados florescem rapidamente e são reunidos no início da manhã usando ferramentas de madeira tradicionais. Este processo de colheita suave deixa os cristais intactos e os ajuda a manter sua umidade natural. Usado por cozinheiros em todo o mundo ao temperar seus alimentos favoritos, o Fleur de Sel é um dos mais valiosos sais de acabamento para pratos gourmet, adicionando salinidade e crocância sutil, e em misturas de especiarias e ervas, pois ajuda a quebrar ervas e abrir seu sabor.

精緻、濕潤、酥脆 - Fleur de Sel 被世界各地的廚師稱為「鹽子醬」。 在法國蓋朗德鹽池表面輕輕吹過涼爽的夜晚風的結果,精緻的水晶迅速綻放,並在清晨使用傳統木製工具收集。 這種溫和的收割過程讓水晶保持完好,並幫助它們保持天然水分。 ​ Fleur de Sel 是美食中最珍貴的成品鹽之一,添加了微妙的鹽味和脆脆,以及香料和草藥混合物,有助於分解草藥並打開風味。

精致、湿润、脆 — Fleur de Sel 被世界各地的厨师称为"鱼子酱"。 在法国盖兰德的盐池表面微风吹拂冷的夜晚,精致的水晶盛开迅速,清晨使用传统木制工具聚集在一起。 这种柔软的收获工艺使晶体完好无损,帮助它们保持天然水分。 世界各地的厨师在调味自己喜爱的食物时,Fleur de Sel 是一款珍贵的成品盐,用来制作美味菜肴,添加微妙的盐分和碎片,添加香料和草药混合物,因为它有助于分解草药,打开他们的口味。

Es ist 100% natürlich. Aus dem Mittelmeer. Dieses Salz liefert kein Jodid, einen notwendigen Nährstoff. Hergestellt aus dem Meer und der Sonne. Seit der Antike ist Salz ein wertvolles Mineral. Es wurde einst Unzen pro Unze für Gold gehandelt und war sogar in der römischen Zeit als Währung verwendet. Das Wort Salary hat seine Bedeutung basierend auf der wichtigen Rolle Salz (sa-le auf Italienisch) im Laufe der Geschichte gespielt hat. Salz ist ein Naturprodukt. Es wird entweder aus dem Boden abgebaut oder durch verdampftes Meerwasser gewonnen. Alessi Meersalz stammt aus den kühlen, blauen Gewässern des Mittelmeers mit der ältesten Methode der Gewinnung von Salz, Verdunstung. Meerwasser wird durch eine Reihe von Verdunstungsteichen übertragen, die erfolgreich andere Elemente beseitigen. Das heiße, trockene Klima und die sanfte Brise beschleunigen den Verdunstungsprozess und hinterlassen nur reine weiße Kristalle und andere wertvolle Spurenmineralien, die nicht in normalem Salz zu finden sind. Die groben Kristalle des Alessi Meersalzes verleihen Ihrem Kochen eine neue Dimension und verleihen ihm Geschmack und Textur. Savvy Gourmets verwenden knusprige Meersalzkristalle in ihren Salzmühlen.
